root_cause.statement: Daily ranking validates assignment fields but does not prove that a Trends implementation can enter the immutable delivery numerator. Generic capability pilots are repeatedly bound to live_completion_rate even when the ledger excludes them.

latest_actual_effect.reason: The immutable delivery ledger did not count the bounded workflow pilot as a selected live delivery task.

smallest_safe_corrective_action: Before publishing a delivery-metric assignment, require a stable immutable denominator_item_id.
Evaluate whether the exact implementation can make that denominator item enter the live numerator under the unchanged formula.
If eligibility is not proven, bind a compatible direct capability metric or emit NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC without consuming the shared 1/4 denominator.
Keep the current queue task READY until this binding gate passes; do not fabricate product credit.

expected_effect.process: Eliminate predictable zero-effect delivery assignments and preserve implementation capacity for a causally eligible task.
expected_effect.raw_target: The next accepted assignment is capable of moving live_completion_rate from 1/4 to 2/4.
expected_effect.credit_policy: No numeric or completion credit until a canonical unchanged-formula ACTUAL_EFFECT receipt proves the raw change.

acceptance: eligibility evidence names the user-visible or business outcome and production route
terminal receipt re-reads the same metric
zero delta is EVALUATED_NO_EFFECT and releases the chain lock
